question: What is the baseline?
choice: Owner master prompt + developer-completeness requirements (2026-10-12) + docs/prompts

question: Is implementation authorised?
choice: Yes: owner instructed "create a fully featured app"
rationale: Explicit owner instruction overrides the master prompt's spec-only clause

question: Which OS/arch are supported?
choice: Windows 11 x64 (primary; Windows 10 22H2 best-effort/UNQUALIFIED); Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 x86-64 (glibc>=2.35) X11/Wayland via Qt; audio stacks WASAPI/MME/DS/WDM-KS and ALSA/JACK/PipeWire-ALSA; ARM64 out of scope
rationale: Owner asked Windows x64 first then Linux x64; Windows 10 is past end of support

question: What hardware is supported/measured?
choice: Minimum: 2-core x64 2015+ / 4 GB / 1366x768 / no GPU; reference machine: owner-designated Windows 11 4-core 8 GB SSD desktop
resolution_method: owner names a reference machine; run tools/benchmark.py and HQ-03
exit_criterion: budgets in spec 16 met on the reference machine

question: Which runtime/toolchain?
choice: CPython 3.11; pins in requirements.lock; PyInstaller 6.22.3; no compiler needed (wheels only)
rationale: Mature scientific stack; no native code justified by profiling

question: Ship ASIO?
choice: Not shipped
resolution_method: obtain Steinberg licence agreement or use a licence-clean ASIO host

question: Which devices are targeted first?
choice: Class-compliant USB interfaces; USB/XLR measurement mics; piezo contact pickups; IEPE accelerometer via conditioner; laptop mic (tier 1)

question: Which MEMS bridge board/firmware?
choice: Protocol v1 + host decoder implemented; board not chosen
resolution_method: bounded feasibility task: compare 2-3 boards (USB CDC rate/noise/cost)
exit_criterion: one board selected and firmware passes the spec 06 §6 acceptance tests

question: Which modes?
choice: Timed free-run capture 1-64 ch single device; stimulus-during-capture; file import; bridge dump import; offline alignment; coordinated simultaneous capture on two or more devices through app service and CLI; mappings estimated against first device
rationale: Honest about independent clocks; validate shared-reference mapping after capture
alternatives_rejected: treating device clocks as inherently synchronized

question: Which formats?
choice: float32 WAV chunks (10 s; RF64 >4 GB) + SQLite JSON documents + npz derived + zip .scarchive; schema 1.0.0 semver; store v1
alternatives_rejected: HDF5; FLAC for raw (float not supported)

question: Which conventions?
choice: FS/unit sensitivity; physical = FS/sensitivity; correction dB to ADD; declared response vs correction files; k=2 uncertainty; 0.1 dB gain tolerance; validity band

question: Which defaults?
choice: Hann; 1 Hz target; 50% overlap; >=8 independent averages; tone prominence 10 dB (evidence 15 dB); coherence alpha 0.05 & practical 0.5; min effect 1 dB; estimated floor 0.5 dB; clip 0.999; silence -140 dBFS; low -80 dBFS; DC 0.01; airborne 6/3 dB; gradient 6 dB; sync budget 0.35 rad; ambiguity 0.8
exit_criterion: thresholds frozen on tuning set and evaluated on held-out set

question: How to package?
choice: PyInstaller onedir; Windows portable ZIP; Linux tar.gz; SHA256SUMS; SBOM; notices; no auto-update

question: Sign Windows builds?
choice: Unsigned
resolution_method: acquire certificate; add signing step in CI

question: Under which licence is SonicClue distributed?
choice: All rights reserved notice until decided

question: What makes a release complete?
choice: 0.1.0 = software-complete hardware-unqualified release; hardware-qualified release needs HQ-01..09 for the DEC-004 list
rationale: Developer-completeness requirements forbid claiming qualification without evidence

question: Use ML or probabilities?
choice: Deterministic ordinal rules only
rationale: No validated dataset or calibration method
resolution_method: collect labelled dataset (>=40 cases) with held-out protocol

question: Which GUI toolkit?
choice: PySide6 + pyqtgraph

question: Write C++/Rust parts?
choice: None
rationale: Profiling showed no hotspot needing native code

question: How are missing values represented?
choice: Optional fields omitted (null treated as absent); TaggedValue for measured values

question: Read newer documents?
choice: Reject newer minor/major; migrate older majors

question: SonicClue or SoniClue?
choice: Product "SonicClue"; repository keeps "SoniClue"; package sonicclue
rationale: Master prompt names the product SonicClue; renaming a repo is an owner action

question: Include a simulator?
choice: Yes; every output labelled SIMULATED

question: Auto-update?
choice: No updater in 0.1; manual download with checksums
resolution_method: design a signed updater after DEC-009a

question: How are reports rendered?
choice: Headless matplotlib figures; reportlab PDF; self-contained HTML
